title: Search for files containing specific text
summary: Use mdfind to find files that contain a specific word or phrase inside them. This searches the content of your documents, not just their names.

aliases.text: как найти файл по содержимому на маке

steps.explain: Run mdfind with your search query in quotes. This searches the text content of files indexed by Spotlight.

placeholders.name: QUERY
placeholders.description: The text or phrase you want to find inside files.
